Hey @arik-dig ,
Yes, there are some places were is very tricky to get the stack trace. 
I think we have some related issues as well.
For now in needs to go to the queue until there's bandwidth for it, sorry
gentle reminder, is there a plan to solve it?

@brunobat I am correct in assuming that currently OpenTelemetry is integrated with pure Vert.x and not RESTEasy Reactive at all?

Asking because it seems to me that none of the exceptions thrown in a JAX-RS method will ever result in the recording of the stacktrace. Correct?
If so, I think this is a duplicate of #27384 which better captures the problem and therefore this issue should be closed in favor of that one.

@geoand there is integration with  [Vert.x](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/f92ac9ac3748efda36fcae2c316f2cd8a222777e/extensions/opentelemetry/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/opentelemetry/runtime/tracing/intrumentation/vertx/InstrumenterVertxTracer.java#L53) and RESTEasy Reactive, and errors are reported if happen in the scope of the [WithSpanInterceptor](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/e723c0b760cbed5d1be2d65106276f839001734c#diff-14c3d405dab89de77925838eef5dfecb08f079e4797475b6644bbaaed64ad723R75).
The problem is that all the exception throwing points might not be covered. Some because they are not being catch and some because they might happen before a route can be determined.
